import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD2 = 998244353L;
    static final int maxk = 7;
    static final int base = 1000000;
    static long n, order;
    static int total;
    static int[] prefix_sum = new int[maxk];
    static List<Integer>[] seqs = new ArrayList[maxk];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxk; i++) {
            seqs[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void build_sequences(long x, int length) {
        order++;
        seqs[length].add((int)(((order - x) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2));
        prefix_sum[length] = (int)((prefix_sum[length] + seqs[length].get(seqs[length].size() - 1)) % MOD1);
        if (length == 6) return;
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            build_sequences(x * 10 + d, length + 1);
        }
    }

    static void traverse(long x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if (x * base + base - 1 <= n && x * base * 10 > n) {
            long current_order = order;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                int sz = seqs[i].size();
                int diff = (int)(((current_order - x * (long)Math.pow(10, i)) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2);
                int pos = lowerBound(seqs[i], (int)((MOD2 - diff) + 0L));
                total = (int)((total + 1L * diff * sz + prefix_sum[i]) % MOD1);
                total = (int)((total - 1L * MOD1 * (sz - pos) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1);
                order += sz;
            }
            return;
        }
        order++;
        total = (int)((total + ((order - x) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2) % MOD1);
        for (int d = 0; d <= 9; d++) {
            traverse(x * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        order = 0;
        build_sequences(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(seqs[i]);
        }
        order = 0;
        total = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            traverse(i);
        }
        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
